rule.name: SpringDataNoFlush
rule.message: Let the transaction write changes at commit and remove this flush; in a batch loop, flush and then call entityManager.clear() every N entities. Any other early flush defeats JDBC batching and hides ordering bugs.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('saveAndFlush', 'saveAllAndFlush', 'flush')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]] [not(ancestor::*[self::ForStatement or self::ForeachStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'peek', 'flatMap', 'mapToObj')] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Iterator')]]]][1] //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'clear'][*[1][(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager'))]])]
